subject.title: feat(android): accept audio and document attachments via share sheet and composer

question: Should the Android client officially support the proposed curated audio and document MIME set in both the system share sheet and chat composer?
rationale: This is a new user-facing mobile capability and permanently defines an intake contract for untrusted external content; a protected maintainer review is needed to confirm the supported file set and UX boundary.

options.title: Accept the curated attachment scope
options.body: Keep the proposed allowlist and require real Android proof plus refreshed checks before merge.

options.title: Narrow the supported formats
options.body: Restrict the first release to the attachment kinds Android owners are prepared to support and document/test that smaller contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the current image-only UX until a broader mobile attachment policy is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept the curated attachment scope
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed allowlist and require real Android proof plus refreshed checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: All supplied head commits in the affected Android share and composer paths are authored by this contributor, though broader main-branch ownership remains unconfirmed.
